All four rulings executed. Nothing committed; everything is in the working tree.

**1. Size exceptions granted.** All 10 entries in `systems/eval-harness/conventions-exceptions.json` now read `granted_by: david, approval: approved`, review dates intact. Linter confirms: 10 acknowledged, none warn.

**2. chase-call-prep deleted.** Impact check first: all references are historical records (meetings, evals, error log, memory, specs) — nothing live wires to it. Removed both `skills/chase-call-prep/` and its `.claude/skills/chase-call-prep/` redirect stub (the stub existed only to point at the retired skill). No manifest entry to remove.

**3. fetch_plaud exceptions recorded.** Both scripts entered under `script.interactive_input` with `review_after: 2026-12-17`. The linter was FAIL-blind to exceptions on this rule, so I added manifest support: an unexpired exception downgrades the finding to `acknowledged`; a decayed one (`review_after` passed) re-raises as FAIL. Both paths now lint clean.

**4. Block delineation, 21 files** (chase-call-prep's deletion dropped it from 24). How I marked each:

- **System = Purpose only; personal = everything from Phase 0 on** (report URLs, report IDs, Obsidian cache paths, chart coordinates, Q1 targets): `new-clients`, `bookings-review`, `co-sell-pipeline`, `revenue-tracker`, `pipeline-snapshot`
- **System = purpose/output format; personal = research sequence + gates** (M365/Clay/OmniFocus MCP bindings): `shep-1on1-prep`
- **Whole body personal, empty system block** — these are inseparable from your accounts: `chase-card-offers-{citi,amex,chase,discover}` (card numbers, 1Password items, YNAB account IDs), `jarvis-inbox`, `grammarly-polish` ("David is already logged into Grammarly"), `plaud-{speaker-id,discover,transcripts}`, `harper-blog-linkedin-post`
- **Mixed, three blocks**: `one-password` (system: references + workflow + secret-write/field-read patterns; personal: Default Account, service-account tokens, tmux session, service-specific workflows); `reddit-monitor` (personal: only the Kare Devices example defaults)
- **Whole body system, empty personal**: `boot-context-analyzer`, `rigby-release-watch`, `agents/manifest.md`

**Final linter state: FAIL 0 (was 27), WARN 172, acknowledged 12. Build-gate mode exits 0.** The two spots most worth your spot-check: the PowerBI skills' split point (I drew the line at Phase 0 — Purpose is system, though it names your vault and One Texas) and the whole-body-personal calls on the card and Plaud skills, where I judged there's no forkable content to separate.
